name: hengliuu-skills
description: A personal agentic engineering workflow for AI coding harnesses: the Golden Rules working-style file, a planning-to-review workflow with gates, engineering guidelines, and portable agent roles. Works as a Claude Code plugin, or on any harness through the skills CLI. On Claude Code, one-shot gates stop the first code write before karpathy-guidelines and the first work-branch merge before a review (HENGLIUU_GATES=off disables them). Layers on superpowers and EGM, installed separately.
